
```{r}
#Load elephant data 
elephant <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc/data/elephant_2010-Feb2020.csv")

head(elephant)
str(elephant)

coord_x <- "Lon"
coord_y <- "Lat"
```
```{r}
#Load all raster tif covariates 

dry_szn <- list.files("~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc/data/baseline_2020_with_spei/dry_szn", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

wet_szn <- list.files("~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc/data/baseline_2020_with_spei/wet_szn", pattern = "\\.tif", full.names = TRUE)

all_raster_files <- c(dry_szn, wet_szn)

print(all_raster_files)

raster_list <-lapply(all_raster_files, rast)
names(raster_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(all_raster_files))

target_crs <- "EPSG:4326" 
my_extent <-ext(18.461667, 25.283338, -20.916664, -17.133330)

raster_list <- lapply(raster_list, function(r) {
  if(crs(r) != crs(target_crs)) {
    r <- project(r, target_crs)
  }
  crop(r, my_extent)
})

template <- raster_list[[1]]
raster_list_aligned <- lapply(raster_list, function(r) {
  if (!compareGeom(r, template, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
    r <- resample(r, template, method = "bilinear")
  }
  r
})

covariates <- rast(raster_list_aligned)

layer_names <- unlist(mapply(function(r, nm) {
  if (nlyr(r) == 1) {
    nm
  } else {
    paste0(nm, "_", 1:nlyr(r))
  }
}, raster_list_aligned, names(raster_list_aligned), SIMPLIFY = FALSE))

names(covariates) <- layer_names
print(covariates)
```

```{r}
#Extract covariate values at elephant points

elephant_pts <- vect(elephant, geom = c(coord_x, coord_y), crs = "EPSG:4326")
elephant_pts <- project(elephant_pts, target_crs)

elephant_vals <- terra::extract(covariates, elephant_pts)
elephants_vals <- elephant_vals[, -1]
elephant_vals <- na.omit(elephant_vals)

```

```{r}
#multicollinearity test
corrplot(cor(elephant_vals), method = "number", type = "upper", tl.cex = 0.7)

vif_result <- vifstep(elephant_vals, th = 10)
print(vif_result)

final_vars <- vif_result@results$Variables
print(final_vars)
```
